articles.title: Bitcoin tops $86,000 ahead of U.S. jobs report
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is up roughly 3% in October as traders await September’s jobs data, while rising bond yields, a stronger dollar weigh on broader markets.

articles.title: Bitcoin kicks off new quarter in the old $82,000-$85,000 price range
articles.snippet: Prices briefly topped $85,000 on Wednesday after weaker-than-expected U.S. inflation cooled bets on Fed rate hikes, But bulls couldn’t hold the move and spot ETFs didn’t help.

articles.title: Bitcoin's soft-inflation pop to $85,500 fades as bond yields refuse to fall
articles.snippet: A cooler-than-expected PCE report sent bitcoin briefly above $85,000 on Wednesday. Treasury yields held near their highest since 2002 and the gains drained away.

articles.title: Bitcoin briefly hits $87K as weak US jobs data sends bond yields lower
articles.snippet: Bitcoin climbed after weaker-than-expected payrolls pushed Treasury yields lower, but order-book resistance kept BTC from reaching new macro highs.

articles.title: BNB Chain crosses $1B in tokenized stocks, ETFs as market hits $3.7B
articles.snippet: Tokenized stocks and ETFs on BNB Chain reached $1.1 billion as the broader market climbed to $3.7 billion, putting the network’s share at roughly 30%.
